https://thefrontierpost.com/czech-govern.text: (AA): The Czech government is expected to approve legislation banning the use of mobile phones and other electronic communication devices in kindergartens, primary schools, and the lower grades of multi-year grammar schools, local media reported on Saturday. The bill, submitted by Prime Minister Andrej Babis and Education Minister Robert Plaga, would extend the ban beyond classrooms to include school breaks, cafeterias and after-school programs, Radio Prague International reported. The proposal provides exemptions for students who require electronic devices for medical reasons or special educational needs. Schools would also be allowed to authorize their use during lessons or school trips when deemed necessary for educational purposes. Children’s Ombudsman Martin Benes criticized the proposal, arguing that schools already have sufficient authority to regulate students’ use of mobile phones through their own internal rules and that additional legislation is unnecessary. https://telex.hu/gazdasag/2026/08/01/mag.text: Menü Kereső Magyar Péter: Vasárnap leáll a Paksi Atomerőmű Gazdaság frissítve Pál Tamás Állítsd be a Telexet megbízható forrásnak! Beállítom „A Duna vízszintjének további csökkenése miatt hajnali 1:30-kor lekapcsolják az utolsó előtti termelő gépegységet a Paksi Atomerőműben” – jelentette be szombat éjjel Magyar Péter. A miniszterelnök szerint így már csak 240 megawattot termel majd az erőmű, amit vasárnap teljesen le is állítanak. A magyar áramtermelés negyven százalékát biztosító Paksi Atomerőmű 44 éves történelme során még soha nem volt szükség teljes leállításra. Az atomerőmű közleménye szerint a Duna vízszintjének csökkenése miatt 2026. augusztus 2-án, 1:30-kor megkezdik a 4. blokk még működő turbinagenerátorának leállítását, ezzel tovább csökken a Paksi Atomerőmű villamosenergia-termelése. Mostantól már csak a 2. blokk működik 50 százalékos teljesítménnyel. Ez a termelési mennyiség addig tartható fenn, amíg a vízszint lehetővé teszi a blokk hűtéséhez használt szivattyú-járókerekek biztonságos működtetését. „A vízszint további csökkenése esetén az utolsó üzemelő blokk is leáll, ezzel teljesen megszűnik a villamos-energia termelés, a továbbiakban az álló blokkok hűtéséről kell gondoskodni” – írták. Az erőmű arra kéri a lakosságot, hogy a következő időszakban mindenki törekedjen a villamosenergia-fogyasztás csökkentésére, különösen a 17 és 22 óra közötti esti csúcsidőszakban. Magyar Péter pénteki, Pakson tartott sajtótájékoztatóján azt mondta, a tervezett ütemben zajlik az atomerőmű leállítása, és ez semmilyen nukleáris veszélyt nem jelent . A termelés kiesése azonban a konzervatív becslések szerint is legalább 50 milliárd forintos plusz kiadást jelenthet a költségvetésnek. Arról, hogy mi hangzott még el a tájékoztatón, itt írtunk bővebben. Az eddigi negatív vízállásrekord 2018-ban volt a Dunán, pénteken 26 centiméterrel voltunk ez alatt. A legfrissebb előrejelzések már mínusz 144 centiméternél is alacsonyabb szintet várnak, és nincs jele annak, hogy ez a trend belátható időn belül megfordulna – mínusz 133 centiméternél jön a teljes leállítás. Ha teljesen le is állnak majd a paksi blokkok, a biztonsági hűtőrendszernek akkor is működnie kell. Ezen felül tizenhat nagy teljesítményű szivattyút rendeltek a vízügyi igazgatóságtól, ebből tizenkettő folyamatosan működni fog, négy marad készenlétben. Nagy László, az erőmű műszaki vezérigazgató-helyettese extrém, soha nem látott helyzetként jellemezte a jelenlegit, amit szerinte a statisztikákból és az előrejelzésekből sem lehetett kiolvasni. https://vietnamnews.vn/politics-laws/180.text: Key Party leader hosts Hungarian Workers’ Party chief HÀ NỘI — Politburo Member and Permanent Member of the Communist Party of Việt Nam (CPV) Central Committee’s Secretariat Trần Cẩm Tú hosted a reception in Hà Nội on Monday for a delegation of the Hungarian Workers’ Party led by its President Gyula Thürmer, who is on a working trip to Việt Nam from October 4-10. The host conveyed best wishes from General Secretary of the CPV Central Committee and President Tô Lâm to the delegation. He praised years of solidarity, friendship and cooperation between the two Parties and countries, stressing that the Vietnamese Party, State and people always value and are grateful for the selfless, wholehearted and faithful support of Hungarian communists and people to Việt Nam in the past struggle for national liberation and reunification, and in the current national construction and defence. He welcomed the Hungarian Workers’ Party’s achievements, especially its steadfast commitment to ideals and Marxism-Leninism. He believed that the Party would keep consolidating its organisation, renewing its operating methods, raising its prestige and standing, and actively contributing to Hungary’s development and higher living standards. The key Party leader affirmed Việt Nam’s determination to meet two 100-year goals of becoming a developing, upper-middle-income country with modern industry by 2030, and a developed, high-income country by 2045. Reaching those targets requires Party building and rectification as a key task, tied to strengthening the Party's leadership, governing capacity and combat strength, and overhauling its leadership methods. All policies are people-centred, linking economic growth with cultural development, upholding discipline and ensuring citizens' security, safety and well-being, he said. Việt Nam will stay on the path to socialism and pursue the foreign policy of independence, self-reliance, peace, friendship, cooperation, development, diversification and multilateralisation of external ties, and active, proactive global integration, he said. He added that the CPV always values its solidarity and friendship with the Hungarian Workers' Party and communist and workers' parties worldwide, which helps build political trust and supports Việt Nam's relations with other countries. Thürmer, in reply, said he is pleased to return to Việt Nam and again congratulated General Secretary and President Lâm on his election as Party chief for the 14th term. He praised Việt Nam's achievements after 40 years of Đổi mới (Renewal), calling them clear proof of the CPV's sound leadership and a source of encouragement and valuable experience for his Party and the international communist and workers' movement. Sharing orientations on Party building and consolidation and praising Việt Nam’s foreign policy, Thürmer affirmed that steadfast adherence to Marxism-Leninism is the right choice for communist parties, and believed that Việt Nam would successfully achieve its development goals through 2030 and its vision to 2045. Citing Việt Nam's growing role and standing in the region and the world, he said the Hungarian Workers' Party and other Hungarian political parties support the government's efforts to deepen the traditional friendship and multifaceted cooperation with Việt Nam in an increasingly close and substantive way. The two sides agreed on five cooperation priorities and more delegation exchanges at all levels and between the parties' advisory bodies. They shared experience in Party building and pledged to use the Party channel to boost cooperation in areas where both have strengths, while giving attention to traditional fields such as education-training, culture and people-to-people exchanges, to strengthen the social foundation for bilateral ties for the benefit of the two countries' people. The discussions helped tighten solidarity between the two Parties, clarify the direction of long-term cooperation and elevate the role of Party diplomacy in deepening the Việt Nam-Hungary Comprehensive Partnership. — VNA/VNS Politics & Law Top Vietnamese leader highlights new horizon for Việt Nam–Denmark cooperation Politics & Law Top leader meets with Danish Parliament Speaker Henrik Frandsen in Copenhagen Politics & Law Liechtenstein Prime Minister concludes official visit to Việt Nam Politics & Law NA President meets with Liechtenstein PM Politics & Law Top leader holds talks with King Frederik X of Denmark Politics & Law Top Vietnamese leader receives Denmark’s highest-ranked honour Politics & Law Việt Nam offers congratulations to newly elected leaders of Laos During the second session of the 10th Lao NA on October 5, Sonexay Siphandone was elected President of the Lao NA, and Saleumxay Kommasith elected Prime Minister of the country.
